newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BCN mum on Rio's Banerj selloff.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BCN mum on Rio's Banerj selloff.

text.p: Brazilian private bank BCN said it would not comment a newspaper report saying the bank is interested in acquiring Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj, due to be privatized on June 17.
"The bank will not make comments on the issue," said a bank spokesman.
However, banking sources said BCN is eyeing the Banerj sale under its strategy to strenghten its retail banking activities.

Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper today said BCN has sent Brazil's Central Bank the necessary documents to prequalify for the privatization auction of Banerj. The prequalification period expires on June 13.
No Central Bank officials were immediately available to confirm the report.
BCN has also been the subject of market rumors that the bank is holding merger talks with foreign banks, including Spain's Bilbao Vizcaya.
The bank also declined to make comments on the rumors.
Early this year BCN decided to end negotiations with local bank Banco BBA Creditanstalt, which was interested in acquiring a controlling stake in the bank.
BCN is Brazil's sixth largest private bank in terms of net worth. Last year, it posted a net profit of 144.8 million reais, for a 15.5 percent annual return on equity.
